children: CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings agreed to be acquired by a group led by buyout shop GTCR for nearly $4.6 billion in cash.
CCC on Thursday said the group, which also includes activist investor Elliott Investment Management, will pay $7.75 a share in cash for the Chicago car-insurance-software company.

The deal represents a slight premium of 2.5% to Wednesday's closing price of $7.56 a share for CCC but is 44% above the July 9 closing price of $5.38 a share--before reports that the company was exploring a potential sale were published.
Trading in shares of CCC was halted premarket on Thursday.
The transaction, which carries an enterprise value of around $6.1 billion, is slated to close in the first quarter of 2027.
